mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OutboundRequest ( outbound_date, approved_status, outbound_address, requested_delivery_date, member_id, warehouse_id, staff_id ) VALUES ( NOW(), 'PENDING', #{outboundAddress}, #{requestedDeliveryDate}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{staffId} );
INSERT INTO OutboundOrder (outbound_request_id, order_status, approved_date) VALUES (#{outboundRequestID}, 'PENDING', NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT si.outbound_item_id AS outboundItemId, p.product_name AS productName, c.category_name AS categoryName, si.outbound_quantity AS outbound_quantity FROM OutboundItem si INNER JOIN Product p ON si.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN Category c ON p.category_cd = c.category_cd WHERE si.outbound_request_id = #{outboundRequestId}

SELECT sr.outbound_request_id AS outbound_request_id, sr.outbound_date, sr.approved_status, sr.outbound_address, sr.requested_delivery_date, M.member_name AS requestUserName, Pt.partner_name AS brandName, st.staff_name AS staffName, COALESCE(d.dispatch_status, '대기') AS dispatch_status, COALESCE(w.waybill_number, '-') AS waybill_number, COALESCE(w.waybill_status, '대기') AS waybill_status, si.outbound_item_id, si.outbound_quantity, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM OutboundRequest sr INNER JOIN Member M ON sr.member_id = M.member_id LEFT JOIN Staff st ON sr.staff_id = st.staff_id LEFT JOIN Partner Pt ON M.partner_id = Pt.partner_id LEFT JOIN OutboundOrder o ON sr.outbound_request_id = o.outbound_request_id LEFT JOIN Dispatch d ON o.approved_order_id = d.approved_order_id LEFT JOIN Waybill w ON w.dispatch_id = d.dispatch_id LEFT JOIN OutboundItem si ON sr.outbound_request_id = si.outbound_request_id LEFT JOIN Product p ON si.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN Category c ON p.category_cd = c.category_cd WHERE sr.outbound_request_id = #{outboundRequestId}
AND sr.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE w FROM Waybill w INNER JOIN Dispatch d ON w.dispatch_id = d.dispatch_id INNER JOIN OutboundOrder o ON d.approved_order_id = o.approved_order_id WHERE o.outbound_request_id = #{outboundRequestId}
DELETE d FROM Dispatch d INNER JOIN OutboundOrder o ON d.approved_order_id = o.approved_order_id WHERE o.outbound_request_id = #{outboundRequestId}
